whenToUse: Contracts, agreements and statements of work signed in place, down to initials per clause
Required form fields, proof of delivery on a phone and a profile signature reused on documents
Mouse, finger or stylus ink exported as PNG, JPEG, SVG or JSON, or uploaded as an image Blob

whenNotToUse.when: A sign in or sign up page where people type an email and a password
A scanned or photographed mark the signer already has as an image
A whole data entry page of typed fields with nothing drawn by hand

agentNotes: Image exports draw ink with no `color` of its own in black, on a transparent background except `jpeg`; pass `background` for paper white
`readOnly` locks a signed pad at full ink strength while `disabled` dims it; both stop input and drop the area from the tab order
With `name` set, keep `format` as `svg` or `json`; `png` and `jpeg` rasterize the hidden form field after every stroke
